title: ONSure RAG Retrieval Assurance Check v1
description: FR-META-058 AI Nondeterminism and Multi-Agent Assurance / 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS6 RAG Assurance: 'RAG identity는 corpus만이 아니라 Corpus -> ACL -> Chunking -> Embedding Model -> Index Build -> Retrieval Policy -> Reranker -> Citation/Source Binding 전체를 포함한다.' Of the nine named verification areas (corpus provenance/rights, ACL preservation, poisoning, stale index, index/corpus mismatch, retrieval omission/over-retrieval, citation correctness, cross-tenant retrieval, embedding/model drift), this operation closes two by real structural computation: cross_tenant_retrieval_detected is a real per-chunk equality check between each retrieved chunk's own declared source_tenant_id and the querying subject's tenant_id -- a chunk retrieved from a different tenant's corpus is a real cross-tenant leak, not a caller-asserted flag. citation_correctness_verified is a real set-membership check -- every chunk_id the answer actually cites must be present in the set of chunk_ids genuinely retrieved for this query; a citation naming a chunk_id absent from retrieved_chunks is a fabricated/hallucinated citation.
